Without this, rd_addr_reg can retain a stale non-zero value from before reset, causing rd_addr_reg != rd_ptr_reg after reset and making the FIFO appear non-empty, which triggers a premature read and asserts m_axis_tvalid. Resetting rd_addr_reg to zero forces the empty condition to hold immediately after reset, preventing the spurious m_axis_tvalid at cycles 13-15."}, {"id": "patch_bdae4e000e5d", "failure_port": "m_axis_tvalid", "source_line": 175, "mechanism": "patch_bdae4e000e5d modifies the USER_ENABLE generate block (line 175, USER_ENABLE assignment) by qualifying it with `(!s_axis_tready)`.
